About this item

  • GERMAN STAINLESS STEEL: Premium blades forged from German stainless steel are rust-resistant and strong enough for all your kitchen tasks.
  • SHARP PRECISION: Superior sharp edge easily glides through tough ingredients with a razor-sharp cutting angle. Chopping and slicing have never been easier.
  • COMFORTABLE GRIP: Ergonomic, chef-approved design is perfectly balanced for comfort and control, so the knife feels like an extension of your hand.
  • PROFESSIONAL DURABILITY: Durable, wear-resistant handle includes a full-tang construction for a professional weight-in-hand.
  • BUILT-IN SHARPENER: NeverDull Technology is conveniently built into the storage block for professional sharpening results that will maintain a razor-sharp edge for over 10 years!
  • EASY HOME SHARPENING: Easy, foolproof sharpening ensures you’ll never experience the frustration of a dull knife again. All you do is swipe the lever on the outside of the block.
  • FOOLPROOF CERAMIC SHARPENING WHEEL: As you swipe, the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel engages your blade at the perfect angle and applies the optimal amount of pressure to restore your edge to sharpness in seconds.
  • COMPLEMENT YOUR KITCHEN: Modern, stylish block design with stainless steel accents fits conveniently on your countertop and complements any kitchen decor.
  • PREMIUM STEAK KNIVES: Impress your guests with professional steakhouse-quality forged German stainless steel steak knives that cut effortlessly through meats without tearing.
  • INCLUDES: 12-piece set includes 8" Chef knife, 5" Santoku knife, 5" Utility knife, 3.5" Paring knife, (x6) Steak knives, Shears, Knife block with NeverDull Technology

Introducing the Ninja Foodi NeverDull Premium Knife System, the premium knives that stay razor-sharp for over 10 years. This versatile set includes forged German stainless steel blades that are durable and perfectly balanced for comfort and control. With only a few swipes of the built-in, foolproof sharpener, this all-in-one system maintains the superior sharp edge you crave use-after-use.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Great Knife set
    Reviewed in the United States on November 11, 2024

    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The Ninja K52015 Foodi NeverDull 15-Piece Knife System is an impressive addition to any kitchen for those who want quality, durability, and a stylish design. This set includes a wood series block, crafted in walnut, giving it a warm, high-end look that fits beautifully on the countertop.

    Pros:

    1. Built-in Sharpener: The standout feature is the NeverDull built-in sharpener, which is incredibly convenient. A quick sharpening stroke every few uses keeps the knives in prime condition without needing additional tools.

    2. German Stainless Steel: The quality of the German stainless steel is immediately noticeable. The knives are sturdy, corrosion-resistant, and retain their sharpness impressively well.

    3. Variety and Versatility: The 15-piece set includes all essential knives, from chef’s and paring knives to steak knives, making it versatile enough for nearly any kitchen task.

    4. Ergonomics and Comfort: Each knife feels balanced and comfortable to hold, with ergonomically designed handles that reduce hand strain, especially when preparing large meals.

    Cons:

    1. Block Size: The block is substantial, which is great for stability, but it can take up a bit of counter space. Smaller kitchens may find this a challenge.

    2. Price Point: While the quality justifies the price, this set is on the premium side. Budget-conscious buyers might find it a significant investment.

    Overall Impression:

    The Ninja K52015 Foodi NeverDull 15-Piece Premium Knife System is a reliable and stylish choice for both casual cooks and culinary enthusiasts. The self-sharpening feature alone makes it worth considering, as it simplifies maintenance and keeps the knives performing like new. For anyone looking for a quality, all-in-one knife set that blends function with aesthetics, this is a top-tier choice.

About this Item

  • GERMAN STAINLESS STEEL: Premium blades forged from German stainless steel are rust-resistant and strong enough for all your kitchen tasks.
  • SHARP PRECISION: Superior sharp edge easily glides through tough ingredients with a razor-sharp cutting angle. Chopping and slicing have never been easier.
  • COMFORTABLE GRIP: Ergonomic, chef-approved design is perfectly balanced for comfort and control, so the knife feels like an extension of your hand.
  • PROFESSIONAL DURABILITY: Durable, wear-resistant handle includes a full-tang construction for a professional weight-in-hand.
  • BUILT-IN SHARPENER: NeverDull Technology is conveniently built into the storage block for professional sharpening results that will maintain a razor-sharp edge for over 10 years!
  • EASY HOME SHARPENING: Easy, foolproof sharpening ensures you’ll never experience the frustration of a dull knife again. All you do is swipe the lever on the outside of the block.
  • FOOLPROOF CERAMIC SHARPENING WHEEL: As you swipe, the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel engages your blade at the perfect angle and applies the optimal amount of pressure to restore your edge to sharpness in seconds.
  • COMPLEMENT YOUR KITCHEN: Modern, stylish block design with stainless steel accents fits conveniently on your countertop and complements any kitchen decor.
  • PREMIUM STEAK KNIVES: Impress your guests with professional steakhouse-quality forged German stainless steel steak knives that cut effortlessly through meats without tearing.
  • INCLUDES: 12-piece set includes 8" Chef knife, 5" Santoku knife, 5" Utility knife, 3.5" Paring knife, (x6) Steak knives, Shears, Knife block with NeverDull Technology

Product Description

Introducing the Ninja Foodi NeverDull Premium Knife System, the premium knives that stay razor-sharp for over 10 years. This versatile set includes forged German stainless steel blades that are durable and perfectly balanced for comfort and control. With only a few swipes of the built-in, foolproof sharpener, this all-in-one system maintains the superior sharp edge you crave use-after-use.
